_comment: DSV4 Flash indexer distribution parameters. Q/K measured from Flash B300 captures (2026-06-02, multi_turn_indexer_studies). Logits from Q9j study (swe_bench_32k). Pro parameters used as fallback for Q/K (very similar dtype/format).

q._comment: Estimated from Pro captures; Flash uses same indexer head config. TODO: measure directly from Flash Q/K captures.

k._comment: Estimated from Pro captures. Flash K-cache: [n_blocks,128,1,132] (128 bytes FP8 + 4 bytes scale). Note: Flash may use FP8 path, not FP4. TODO: verify.

weights._comment: Estimated; similar pattern to Pro with smaller scale.

logits._comment: From Q9j study (swe_bench_32k, 21 GVR layers). Flash logits have weaker negative bias than Pro.

temporal._comment: Flash hit-rate measured from Q9j. Much lower than Pro.
